items.title: Dartmouth endowment’s crypto exposure drops by $2M amid falling prices
items.whyYouShouldCare: Dartmouth's reduced crypto exposure signals potential caution among institutional investors, which may impact liquidity and sentiment towards Solana and other cryptocurrencies.

items.title: Israel’s largest bank taps Galaxy to offer bitcoin, ether and solana trading
items.whyYouShouldCare: Israel's largest bank offering Solana trading enhances the asset's legitimacy and accessibility, potentially increasing user engagement and liquidity in the Solana ecosystem.

items.title: Inside Bitwise’s tokenized Solana ETF plan and what comes next
items.whyYouShouldCare: Bitwise's plan for a tokenized Solana ETF could attract institutional capital, bolstering Solana's market positioning and expanding its investor base.
